$comment: The --theme-* contract for @gjuoun/bigface-ui. A theme file (src/themes/<id>.css, generated by scripts/gen-tokens.ts from src/themes/roles.ts) sets ONLY these variables: every `required` key, and any `optional` key. scripts/theme-check.ts enforces it.
$modes: Every theme file has a light block ([data-theme="<id>"]) and a dark block (the same selector plus [data-mode="dark"], or a dark ancestor), and the dark block restates every required key. The gray ramp is role-ordered, not light-to-dark: gray-100 is always the subtlest fill and gray-700 always the strongest text in both modes.

required.--theme-primary: Primary action AND the selected state (CTA, active nav, pressed toggles, current page)
required.--theme-primary-edge: Darker primary — the CTA's bottom edge, banner border
required.--theme-frame: App frame (sidebar), dark code boxes, showcase hero
required.--theme-gray-100: Neutral ramp, subtlest fill (zebra rows, addons)
required.--theme-gray-600: Neutral ramp (labels, KPI titles, total row)
required.--theme-gray-700: Neutral ramp, strongest text (card titles, secondary text)
required.--theme-info: Info — links, file actions, switch on, focus ring by default
required.--theme-radius: Base corner radius (lg); sm/md/xl… derive from it

optional.--theme-press: Scale applied on :active (the press feel). Default: 0.97
optional.--theme-hover: Hover scale for an interactive surface (1 = no movement). Default: 1
optional.--theme-weight: Heading weight, so a feel can be heavier or flatter in its type. Default: 600
optional.--theme-ease: Default transition timing function. Default: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)
optional.--theme-surface: Card and popover fill. Default: gray-100
optional.--theme-frame-accent: Active nav fill on frame. Default: primary-tint
optional.--theme-on-frame-accent: Active nav text on frame. Default: primary
optional.--theme-frame-border: Hairlines on frame. Default: color-mix(on-frame 8%, transparent)
optional.--theme-primary-tint: 10% primary fill (nav hover). Default: color-mix(primary 10%, transparent)
optional.--theme-success-tint: Success badge background. Default: color-mix(success 12%, canvas)
optional.--theme-danger-tint: Danger badge background. Default: color-mix(danger 12%, canvas)
optional.--theme-info-tint: Info badge background. Default: color-mix(info 12%, canvas)
optional.--theme-highlight-tint: Highlight badge background. Default: color-mix(highlight 12%, canvas)
optional.--theme-solid: An always-legible chip surface. Default: frame
optional.--theme-on-solid: Text/icons on a solid fill. Default: on-frame
optional.--theme-space: Base spacing unit; Tailwind's p-/m-/gap-/h- utilities multiply it. Default: 0.25rem

$feel: The three themes share one colour system: every colour role resolves the native Bigface palette, and a theme chooses only the feel — density (space), type scale, radius, elevation, motion, press.
